verdict.rationale: Pydantic AI supports token streaming across most providers (per maintainer comment) and exposes Agent.iter() for accessing intermediate steps/tool calls, but community evidence explicitly notes that turning these primitives into UI-ready structured events (reconnection, event formatting, history across turns) requires substantial extra glue work, and some models historically failed to stream at all. missing for 10: first-party UI-streaming example/SDK for tool-call/step events, confirmation all providers support intermediate event streaming, and resolution of the noted historical streaming gaps.
